events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
# Extract foreground from DESeqResults without requiring DESeq2.
x <- readRDS('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
a <- attributes(x)
df <- data.frame(gene=a"'$rownames, a$listData, check.names=FALSE)
foreground <- df$gene[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
result_genes <- df$gene

# Fetch KEGG PA14 pathway links and names.
links <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(links) <- c('gene','pathway')
links"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', links"'$gene)
links$pathway <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', links"'$pathway)
path_names <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(path_names) <- c('pathway','description')

# Use experiment-eligible genes that map to KEGG pathways as the ORA universe.
universe <- intersect(result_genes, unique(links"'$gene))
fg <- intersect(foreground, universe)
N <- length(universe)
n <- length(fg)

by_path <- split(links$gene, links$pathway)
rows <- lapply(names(by_path), function(pid) {
  genes <- intersect(unique(by_path[[pid]]), universe)
  k <- sum(fg %in% genes)
  M <- length(genes)
  p <- phyper(k - 1, M, N - M, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
  data.frame(pathway=pid, M=M, Count=k, pvalue=p, geneID=paste(sort(intersect(fg, genes)), collapse='"'/'))
})
enrich <- do.call(rbind, rows)
enrich"'$padj <- p.adjust(enrich$pvalue, method='"'BH')
enrich <- merge(enrich, path_names, by='pathway', all.x=TRUE)
enrich <- enrich[order(enrich"'$pvalue, enrich$pathway),]
abc <- enrich[grep('"'"'^ABC transporters'"', enrich"'$description),]
cat('"'foreground_total=', length(foreground), '\\n', sep='')
cat('foreground_mapped=', n, '\\n', sep='')
cat('universe_mapped=', N, '\\n', sep='')
print(abc[,c('pathway','description','M','Count','pvalue','padj','geneID')], row.names=FALSE)
RS"

x <- readRDS('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
a <- attributes(x)

fg <- df$gene[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
links <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

links"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', links"'$gene)
links$pathway <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', links"'$pathway)
paths <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(paths) <- c('pathway','description')
for (mode in c('all_kegg','result_mapped')) {
  universe <- if (mode == 'all_kegg') unique(links"'$gene) else intersect(df$gene, unique(links$gene))
  fgm <- intersect(fg, universe)
  by_path <- split(links$gene, links$pathway)
  out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(by_path), function(pid) {
    genes <- intersect(unique(by_path[[pid]]), universe)
    k <- sum(fgm %in% genes)
    data.frame(pathway=pid, Count=k, pvalue=phyper(k-1, length(genes), length(universe)-length(genes), length(fgm), lower.tail=FALSE))
  }))
  out$padj <- p.adjust(out$pvalue, '"'BH')
  out <- merge(out, paths, by='pathway')
  abc <- out[grep('"'^ABC transporters'"', out"'$description),]
  cat(mode, '"'N=', length(universe), 'n=', length(fgm), 'Count=', abc"'$Count, '"'pvalue=', abc"'$pvalue, '"'padj=', abc"'$padj, '"'\\n')
}

x <- readRDS('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
a <- attributes(x)
df <- data.frame(gene=a"'$rownames, a$listData, check.names=FALSE)
fg <- df$gene[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
links <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(links) <- c('gene','pathway')
links"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', links"'$gene); links$pathway <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', links"'$pathway)
paths <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE); names(paths)=c('pathway','description')
for (unimode in c('all_kegg','result_mapped')) {
 universe <- if (unimode=='all_kegg') unique(links"'$gene) else intersect(df$gene, unique(links$gene))
 fgm <- intersect(fg, universe)
 rows <- lapply(split(links$gene, links$pathway), function(g) {
  genes <- intersect(unique(g), universe); M <- length(genes); k <- sum(fgm %in% genes)
  c(M=M, Count=k, pvalue=phyper(k-1, M, length(universe)-M, length(fgm), lower.tail=FALSE))
 })
 out <- data.frame(pathway=names(rows), do.call(rbind, rows), row.names=NULL)
 for (minGS in c(1,10)) {
  tmp <- out[out$M >= minGS & out$M <= 500,]
  tmp$padj <- p.adjust(tmp$pvalue,'"'BH')
  tmp <- merge(tmp, paths, by='pathway')
  abc <- tmp[grep('"'^ABC transporters'"', tmp"'$description),]
  cat(unimode, '"'minGS', minGS, 'tested', nrow(tmp), 'ABC Count', abc"'$Count, '"'p', abc"'$pvalue, '"'padj', abc"'$padj, '"'\\n')
 }
}
RS"
